report:
Comparison made to multiple prior examinations.

There remains a stable looking chondroid type lesion at the anterior aspect of the distal supracondylar femur, once more not displaying any accompanying aggressive imaging features.

Tiny suprapatellar effusion, with no intra-articular bodies nor any overt synovitis.
No Baker's cyst formation.

Structurally intact menisci, cruciate and collateral ligaments, distal iliotibial band, extensor tendons and popliteus musculotendinous unit.

Grade 3 cartilage fissure noted at the median ridge of the patella, best appreciated on axial imaging.
Well-maintained remaining tricompartmental hyaline articular cartilage surfaces.

No accompanying anterior fat pad impingement.
Grossly unremarkable imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

In the medial compartment, there is radial tear at the posterior root of the medial meniscus. There is displaced meniscal fragment into the medial gutter. There is diffuse high grade and low grade chondrosis (less than and more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along weightbaring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. There is subchondral edema. Osteophytes are present. 
  
 The lateral compartment, there is small horizontal tear at the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is focal high grade chondrla defectat mid lateral tibial plateau (about 1.2* 1.1 cm). There is no subchondral edema. Osteophytes are present.  
  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is diffuse low grade and high grade chondrosis (less than and more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along medial and lateral trochleas, medial and lateral patellar facets. There is subchondral edema. Osteophytes are present. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior cruciate ligament is intact. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is no tibial translation. 
  
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Some amount of left knee effusion with synovitis is present. A 1.5*1.5* 4.5 cm baker's cyst at the posteromedial aspect of left knee. The surrounding musculature is normal.  Tricompartmental osteoarthritis of the left knee by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral edema, and osteophytes. 
  Radial tear at the posterior root of the medial meniscus. (note: meniscal extrusion into the medial gutter). 
  Suspected small horizontal tear at the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus.  
  Some amount of left knee effusion with synovitis and 1.5*1.5* 4.5 cm baker's cyst.

Rodilla traumática aguda izquierda. [DATE].

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain; history of injury of the hamstrings 9 months ago; burning pain at the posterior aspect of the knee
Comparison: Radiograph of the right and left knees dated [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is subtle cartilage fissuring at the medial facet of the patella. There is no cartilage defect of the trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 15 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Intact menisci and ligaments.

2. Minimal cartilage fissuring at the medial patellar facet.

3. Trace Baker's cyst.

Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler normal. Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Ön çapraz bağda kronik tam kat yırtık gözleniyor. Arka çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Lateral menisküs normal. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzunda horizontal longitudinal alt eklem yüzeyi ile ilişkilenen ve periferal zonda vertikal bileşenleri olan kompleks yırtık izleniyor. Posteromedyal köşe yapıları korunmuş. Gastroknemyus-semimembranozus bursasındaki en çok 5 mm kalınlıktaki sıvı lokülasyonu sızdırmıyor. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.

Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal femoral tibyal kompartmanda en belirgin ve tam kata ulaşan eklem kıkırdağı kaybı ve dejenerasyonu, subkondral medüller fibrokistik ve fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve marjinal osteofitlerle karakterize. Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Ön çapraz bağda mukoid dejenerasyon. Arka çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Tibyal platonun lateralinde eklem yüzeyinde 2 mm çökmeye neden olmuş kırığı yaygın kemik iliği ödemi çevreliyor. Tibyal platonun mediyalindeki subkondral kırık kemik iliği ödemi ile birlikte. Fibula başındaki nondeplase inkomplet kırığı kemik iliği ödemi çevreliyor. Mediyal menisküsün arka kökünde tam kat yırtık izleniyor. Mediyal menisküsün gövdesindeki ve arka boynuzundaki üst ve alt eklem yüzeylerine ulaşan kompleks dejeneratif yırtık arka boynuzda doku kaybı ile birlikte. Lateral menisküsün arka boynuzunda alt eklem yüzeyiyle ilişkilenen horizontal oblik yırtık ve serbest kenarda gövdede radyal yırtık izleniyor. Prepatellar cilt altı bağ dokusu ödemli. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş.

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs posterior hornunda grade III dejenerasyon ve horizontal yırtık ile uyumlu sinyal değişiklikleri izlenmektedir. Medial menisküs ekstrüde izlendi. Lateral menisküs normaldir. Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ  normaldir. Lateral kollateral ligaman doğaldır. Medial  kollateral ligaman çevresinde hafif sıvı artışı izlendi(grade I sprain).Prepateller düzeyde cilt altı yağlı dokuda belirgin ödematöz değişiklikler, sinyal artışları izlenmektedir. Patellar kemik doğaldır. Pateller kıkırdakta yer yer hafif incelmeler  izlenmektedir (Tip II kondromalazi). Patellar tendonda tendinozis bulguları mevcuttur.Lateral ve medial reseslerde sıvı artışı izlendi.Lateral retinakulumda  sinyal artışı mevcuttur. Femur medial kondil düzeyinde  kemik iliği ödemi ve bu düzeyde subkondral milimetrik kistler izlenmektedir. Diz eklemini çevreleyen komşu kemik yapılarda osteofitik sivrileşmeler , eklem mesafesinde azalma izlendi. Ayrıca femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda yer yer incelme ve bütünlük kaybı subkondral skleroz izlendi(dejeneratif artrit bulguları).

TECHNIQUE:  Unenhanced multiplanar multisequence MR images of the knee.

CLINICAL INDICATION:  Injury 48 hours ago with knee fixed in flexion 15 degrees. History of JRA, previously was often swollen for years. 8 months ago plant and pivot injury.

COMPARISON:  Knee radiographs [Date]

FINDINGS:

Medial meniscus:  Intact.

Medial compartment articular cartilage:  Intact.

MCL:  Intact.

Lateral meniscus:  Intact.

Lateral compartment articular cartilage:  Intact.

LCL complex:  Intact.

ACL:  Intact.

PCL:  Intact.

Quadriceps and patellar tendons:  Intact.

Patellofemoral alignment:  Normal. 

Patellofemoral cartilage:  Thinning of the cartilage at the inferomedial aspect of the patella with underlying mild osseous edema, indicating focal full thickness cartilage denuding. The corresponding medial femoral trochlear cartilage is slightly thinned compared to the lateral.

Joint effusion:  Small volume joint effusion predominantly at the patellofemoral joint. No synovial thickening.

Intra-articular bodies:  There is a small 0.9 cm osseous body in the anterolateral aspect of the tibiofemoral joint, also shown radiographically.

Bone marrow:  Mild osseous edema of the inferomedial patella. The bone marrow otherwise is unremarkable.

Popliteal fossa:  Normal.

Other findings:  No joint synovitis or tenosynovitis. No erosions or periostitis.


INTERPRETATION:

1. Focal high-grade chondrosis patellar apex.
2. No evidence of discrete meniscal, ligament, or tendon tear.
3. There is a 0.9 cm intra-articular loose osseous body in the anterolateral aspect of the tibiofemoral joint.
4. No evidence of active inflammatory arthritis.
